label: US-CA-AB2504-2026 SECTION 1. / 78026.4.

obligations.text: (a)On or before January 1, 2032, the chancellor’s office shall submit a report to the Legislature evaluating the effectiveness of the pilot program at community colleges participating in the pilot program.

(b)(1)The report submitted pursuant to subdivision (a) shall include, but not be limited to, the number of participants who completed the pilot program, a comprehensive list of the certificates or degrees awarded to participants who completed the pilot program, and outcomes and job placement rates of participants who completed the pilot program.
(2)The data described in paragraph (1) shall be disaggregated by student demographics.
(c)The report submitted pursuant to subdivision (a) shall include outcomes and legislative recommendations.
(d)The report submitted pursuant to subdivision (a) shall be submitted in compliance with Section 9795 of the Government Code.
